_comment: Copy this file to data/content/YYYY-MM-DD.json and fill in the classes that meet that day. Any class you leave out uses data/content/default.json. Segment types: slide, youtube, edpuzzle, run-video, quiz (or game), procedure. procedure uses ref from data/procedures.json. Put the Edpuzzle assignment URL in url. youtube uses an 11-character video id. flex:true marks the block that shrinks when the class starts late. End time is the bell — do not schedule past it.

hs-stem.title: Title that shows under the class name
hs-stem.standby: What they should do the moment they walk in.

segments.title: Launch
lines: First line is the big text
Second line is the smaller line under it.
